messages:
Maria Chen: Quick question — we need to make model routing policy changes auditable in the console. Basically: who changed routing, when, old vs new policy, and an optional 'reason' field. Thoughts on event shape + export UX?

Tyler Wong: +1. We already emit config.update events but it's currently just diffs in the blob. Not friendly for exports or plain CSV.

Jess Rivera: For exports we need flat fields: actor, org_id, resource_type, resource_id, field_changed, old_value, new_value, reason, ip, user_agent, timestamp. CSV for small exports, Parquet for bulk.

Audit-bot: export job created: id=job_20260318_82; estimated size 1.2GB

Samir Patel: Parquet is better for compliance teams (schema + partitioning). But frontend needs quick preview (first 200 rows). Suggest async job + signed S3 link.

Maria Chen: How do we handle masked PII? e.g., user emails in old_value/new_value. Masking rules per org or export role?

Leo Anders: Add a 'redaction_level' column and export can have redaction_level=none/partial/full. Admins can request full with justification + 2FA.

DevEx - Ina: UX: in console export modal include presets: last 7d full, last 90d compliance, custom. Show estimated row count and quota impact. Quota question: should exports count against tenant API quota?

Tyler Wong: They shouldn't eat runtime API quota. Make export quota separate (billing/usage). Also need rate-limited streaming for small previews.

Jess Rivera: API design sketch:

```
GET /v1/audit/logs?org=...&from=...&to=...&resource_type=routing_policy&format=parquet

Response: 202 Accepted { "job_id": "job_..." } -> GET /v1/audit/exports/{job_id} returns status + presigned_url
```

Samir Patel: Support incremental streaming API for SIEM consumers (server-sent events / webhook). Export job for historical dump.

Maria Chen: One more: rollouts UX — when a canary changes routing, we need to surface both planned rollout and applied change. Maybe event type 'rollout.plan' and 'rollout.apply' with rollout_id.

Audit-bot: export job job_20260318_82 completed successfully. presigned_url=https://s3.amazonaws.com/compliance-exports/job_20260318_82.parquet?X-Amz-Expires=3600 expires=2026-03-19T14:00Z :white_check_mark:

Tyler Wong: I'll spin up a PR to add flat fields and redaction_level. Will add tests for CSV/Parquet export and job lifecycle.

Maria Chen: Thanks — can we get an end-to-end demo for compliance next week? @Jess @Samir

Jess Rivera: yep, I'll mock a small tenant export and demo the signed link flow. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: I'll write docs for retention and redaction policy.
